round_20261011_quick_scan_repeat_cost.question: Why do the already-stable scans get rescanned on every local iteration?
round_20261011_quick_scan_repeat_cost.answer: They are not rescanned on every iteration, and a successful scan is not re-run for reassurance. Each of the three scans is content-addressed: trusted_scan_scope.derive_scope looks for a coverage receipt on an ancestor commit whose authority digest equals the digest of the current tree, and the scan then runs INCREMENTAL (measured ~73s: secrets 16.6 / personal 21.4 / history 35.4) instead of FULL (~493s, measured 121.9+143.7+227.7). Full mode is selected only when an input to the scan DECISION changed. The decision inputs are: the scanner and its rules/config (AUTHORITY[kind]); the scope resolver and its shared consumers (COMMON_AUTHORITY: local_quick_evidence.py, trusted_scan_scope.py, local_dev_frontend_quick.py, Makefile); and every make/*.mk file. That last item is the deliberate over-approximation: a make edit can silently change the scan command, so a fail-closed gate must rescan rather than trust a proof whose command text it cannot attribute. It is also why this round's own edits (make/ci.mk, scripts/ci/trusted_scan_scope.py, scripts/ops/local_quick_evidence.py) forced all three kinds to mode=full reason=scan_authority_changed.
round_20261011_quick_scan_repeat_cost.cost_bound_removed_this_round: The full-scan penalty is now paid concurrently instead of serially: security.trusted_scan.group runs the three independent read-only scans as separate make processes. make-level -j cannot do this because make/ci.mk declares .NOTPARALLEL for the local lane (measured: -j3 accepted and then ignored, 7m14s serial signature). Measured wall 231.8s vs 493.3s serial sum.
round_20261011_quick_scan_repeat_cost.remaining_known_over_invalidation: authority_digest binds all of make/*.mk and the whole Makefile, so an edit to an unrelated make fragment still invalidates all three kinds. Narrowing it to the resolved command surface of the governed targets is a P4 open item that needs owner sign-off: it is a fail-closed boundary and a wrong narrowing would reuse a proof across a changed scan command.
round_20261011_quick_scan_repeat_cost.not_relaxed: No scan, assertion, coverage or gate was removed or weakened; no member target was re-implemented; a non-zero member still fails the group and the lane.
